strongest_angle: The emergence of IdeaLens shifts the focus of AI detection from linguistic style to conceptual origin, challenging our understanding of human versus machine creativity in scientific research.

key_facts.fact: Nature reported on October 13, 2026, that a new tool called IdeaLens can distinguish between human and AI-generated concepts within scientific papers.
Researchers including Rishanth Rajendhran and Minjoon Choi developed IdeaLens to address the limitation of existing detectors like Pangram, which only analyze prose.
IdeaLens functions by converting documents into detailed, role-labelled paraphrased outlines to isolate the underlying ideas from the written text.
